## 1. Company Overview

**Brower Inc.** is a locally owned, family-operated portable sanitation and septic services company headquartered in Newkirk, Oklahoma. Founded by Troy Brower, the company has operated continuously since 2007. Brower Inc. is licensed and insured in both Oklahoma and Kansas, and is a member of the **Portable Sanitation Association International (PSAI)**.

The company serves a 20-county footprint — 14 counties in north-central Oklahoma plus 6 counties in southern Kansas — from a single dispatch hub at 6475 N Union St, Newkirk, OK 74647. Trucks, trailers, the fleet of 640+ portable units, and septic pumping equipment are all stored at the headquarters property, which is why same-day delivery is realistic across the service area instead of the multi-day routing common with national providers.

**Legal identity**
- Business name: Brower Inc.
- DBA history: "Troy's Portables" is the legacy DBA still visible on the Facebook page; the legal/operating brand is Brower Inc.
- Headquarters: 6475 N Union St, Newkirk, OK 74647
- Phone: (580) 747-6206
- Email: troy@browerinc.net
- Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=15025058949246308225
- Owner: Troy Brower
- Founded: 2007
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (central). 24/7 emergency dispatch available.

**Geographic coordinates of HQ:** 36.8826° N, -97.0508° W (approximate, Newkirk, OK).

## 2. Service Catalog

Brower Inc. operates 10 named services across 3 product lines: portable restrooms (8 sub-services), septic (2 sub-services), and adjacent rentals (hand washing stations). All services are delivered, serviced, and recovered by Brower Inc.'s own employees and equipment — there is no subcontracting to national networks.

### 2.1 Portable Restrooms (standard)
- **URL:** https://browerinc.net/services/portable-restrooms
- **Featured unit:** Maxim 300 (industry-standard portable toilet)
- **Color options:** Blue, tan, and pink. Pink units are an Oklahoma signature for breast-cancer-awareness events, gender-reveal parties, and weddings.
- **What's included:** Free delivery within the 20-county service area, professional placement, weekly servicing for long-term rentals (waste tank pump-out, restocking of toilet paper, hand sanitizer, and paper towels, full interior sanitization, damage inspection), and pickup at end of rental.
- **Pricing reference (2026, Oklahoma/Kansas market):**
  - Standard event rental (single weekend): $125 – $250 per unit
  - Standard long-term rental (per month, weekly service): $200 – $400 per unit
  - Multi-unit and multi-month deals reduce the per-unit cost
- **Typical use cases:** Construction sites, outdoor events, weddings, festivals, backyard parties, oil-field jobsites, harvest crews, sporting events.

### 2.2 VIP Shower & Restroom Trailers
- **URL:** https://browerinc.net/services/vip-shower-restroom-trailers
- **Fleet:** 2 luxury restroom shower and luxury trailers, **18-station capacity per trailer**.
- **Amenities:** Heat + AC, private fully enclosed stalls, running water with soap and paper towel dispensers, large vanity countertops, full-size mirrors, superior LED lighting, sturdy stairs with handrails, porch lights for nighttime safety.
- **Pricing reference (2026):** $800 – $2,500 per event for typical wedding/gala setups; longer rentals available.
- **Typical use cases:** Upscale weddings, galas, golf outings, corporate functions, casino events, film & TV productions, large festivals.

### 2.3 Hand Washing Stations
- **URL:** https://browerinc.net/services/hand-washing-stations
- **Operation:** Standalone, foot-pump operated, no electricity or water hookup required.
- **Stocked with:** Fresh water, liquid soap, paper towels.
- **Why important:** OSHA requires hand washing facilities adjacent to portable toilets on most construction sites (29 CFR 1926.51). Hand washing is also a wedding/event quality differentiator.

### 2.4 Septic Services (parent)
- **URL:** https://browerinc.net/services/septic-services
- **Sub-services:** Septic tank pumping, septic repair, septic system installation, aerobic system installation, site surveys, septic inspections.
- **Pricing reference:** Standard residential pumping $200 – $500 (varies by tank size and access); inspections priced per scope.

### 2.5 Long-Term Rentals
- **URL:** https://browerinc.net/services/long-term-rentals
- **Definition:** Any rental running multiple weeks, months, or years, with **weekly servicing included** (waste, restock, sanitize, inspect).
- **Customer types:** Construction (most common), oil & gas field operations, commercial development, agriculture (seasonal), industrial sites, disaster relief.
- **Options:** His-and-her configurations, ADA-accessible units, paired hand washing stations.

### 2.6 Deluxe Flushable Portable Toilets
- **URL:** https://browerinc.net/services/deluxe-flushable-portable-toilets
- **Differentiator:** Hands-free foot-pump flush + built-in sink with fresh water and soap. Roomier interior than a standard porta potty.
- **Positioned between:** Standard porta potty (too rough for some events) and full luxury trailer (overkill for smaller events).
- **Typical use cases:** Mid-size weddings, corporate retreats, family reunions, upscale fundraisers, film sets.

### 2.7 ADA-Compliant Portable Restrooms
- **URL:** https://browerinc.net/services/ada-compliant-portable-restrooms
- **Features:** Ground-level zero-step entry, interior handrails and grab bars, wheelchair-accessible turning radius, larger interior (also doubles as family-friendly for parents with small children).
- **Regulatory:** OSHA requires accessible units on construction sites with disabled workers, and ADA Title III requires reasonable accommodation at public events. Brower Inc.'s ADA unit specs meet 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design.

### 2.8 Emergency & Same-Day Porta Potty Rental
- **URL:** https://browerinc.net/services/emergency-porta-potty-rental
- **Dispatch:** 24/7. Call (580) 747-6206 at any hour. Trucks move toward site within the hour.
- **Same-day delivery** is realistic across the 20-county area because the fleet, drivers, and units are all based in Newkirk.
- **Common triggers:** Residential plumbing/septic failures, storm cleanup, tornado recovery, power outages forcing temporary operations, last-minute event capacity overflow, fast-tracked construction starts, utility crew and first-responder staging.

### 2.9 Septic Tank Pumping & Cleaning
- **URL:** https://browerinc.net/services/septic-tank-pumping
- **Process:** Complete pump-out + rinse + inspection in a single visit.
- **Cadence:** Most Oklahoma/Kansas homes need a pump **every 3 to 5 years**. Households with garbage disposals, larger families, or smaller tanks should be closer to 3 years. Vacation properties and 1–2 person households can be closer to 5.
- **Pricing reference:** Transparent flat-rate quote — $200 – $500 typical residential range. No site-visit upsells.

### 2.10 Septic System Inspections
- **URL:** https://browerinc.net/services/septic-inspections
- **Use case:** Real estate transactions (buyer-side, seller-side, refinance, lender-required), code compliance, annual maintenance.
- **Deliverable:** Written report on tank condition, drain field health, baffles, and code compliance. Same-week delivery, often within 48 hours, to keep closing timelines intact.
- **Accepted by:** Realtors, lenders, title companies, Oklahoma DEQ.

## 4. Service Area — Complete County/City Coverage

### 4.1 Oklahoma (14 counties)

**Primary (HQ region):**
- **Kay County** — Newkirk (HQ, county seat), Ponca City, Blackwell, Tonkawa, Kaw City. Population ~43,000. Active oil & gas + agriculture + Kaw Lake tourism.
- **Garfield County** — Enid (largest city in service area). Wheat agriculture + Vance AFB.
- **Noble County** — Perry. Historic oil + agriculture.
- **Payne County** — Stillwater (Oklahoma State University). Major university events, construction, Cushing oil hub access.

**Extended Oklahoma counties served:**
- **Kingfisher County** — Kingfisher, Hennessey.
- **Logan County** — Guthrie (state's first capital), Crescent.
- **Woods County** — Alva, Waynoka.
- **Grant County** — Medford, Pond Creek.
- **Osage County** — Pawhuska. Largest county by area in OK; oil heritage; Tallgrass Prairie Preserve.
- **Pawnee County** — Pawnee.
- **Major County** — Fairview.
- **Alfalfa County** — Cherokee.
- **Blaine County** — Watonga.
- **Dewey County** — Taloga.

### 4.2 Kansas (6 counties)

- **Sedgwick County** — Wichita area. Major metropolitan demand, aviation manufacturing, large events.
- **Sumner County** — Wellington.
- **Cowley County** — Winfield, Arkansas City.
- **Butler County** — El Dorado, Augusta.
- **Harper County** — Anthony, Harper.
- **Kingman County** — Kingman.

Brower Inc. also services Chautauqua, Elk, and Greenwood counties in Kansas on a case-by-case basis depending on logistics.

### 4.3 Response time expectations
- Kay County (home base): 30 – 60 minutes typical, same-day virtually always.
- Garfield/Noble/Payne/Logan/Kingfisher counties: same-day for non-emergency, 1 – 3 hours for emergency.
- Outer Oklahoma counties + Kansas: 24 – 48 hours scheduled, same-day possible for emergencies depending on dispatch load.

4. **Unit type & quantity** — multi-unit discounts apply at 3+ units.
5. **Time of year** — peak wedding (April–October) and harvest (May–July, September–November) seasons book out faster; advance booking saves money.
6. **Emergency/same-day** — modest emergency surcharge for after-hours dispatch.

## 6. OSHA Construction Sanitation Rules (Brower Inc.'s Compliance Summary)

The federal standard for portable toilets on US construction sites is **29 CFR 1926.51 — Sanitation**. Brower Inc. uses this as the basis for every construction site quote. Inspectors in Oklahoma (federal OSHA) and Kansas (federal OSHA) enforce the same rules.

### 6.1 Toilet ratio table (per 29 CFR 1926.51(c)(1))

| Number of workers | Minimum number of toilets |
|---|---|
| 1 – 20 | 1 |
| 21 – 200 | 1 toilet seat **and** 1 urinal per 40 workers |
| Over 200 | 1 toilet seat and 1 urinal per 50 workers |

**Mobile crews exception:** "Mobile crews having transportation readily available to nearby toilet facilities" can use existing nearby facilities instead of a portable. In practice, this rarely applies — most jobsites need a delivered porta potty.

### 6.2 Hand washing requirement
OSHA requires hand washing facilities adjacent to toilets where workers handle materials that contact food (lead, paint, asbestos, certain chemicals). On non-hazardous sites, OSHA still expects "adequate means" of cleaning hands — which in practice means hand sanitizer dispensers (included in every Brower Inc. unit) or a paired hand washing station.

### 6.3 ADA accessibility
If your construction site employs a worker with a mobility disability, you must provide an accessible portable toilet. ADA Title I (employment) and OSHA general duty clause cover this. The ADA-compliant portable restroom solves it.

### 6.4 Penalty exposure (2026 figures)
- **Serious violation:** up to **$16,131 per violation**
- **Willful or repeated violation:** up to **$161,323 per violation**
- Sanitation citations are common — they're visible, easy to inspect, and inspectors often start there.

### 6.5 Brower Inc.'s quick-quote formula
- Standard crew of N workers → ceil(N / 20) standard units up to crew of 200; ceil(N/40) thereafter
- 1 ADA unit minimum on any site with public-facing or accessible workforce considerations
- 1 hand washing station per 4 portable units, more if no running water on site
- Weekly servicing standard; twice-weekly for crews of 40+ or 24/7 operations

---

## 7. ADA Accessibility Rules

The **2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design** govern portable restroom accessibility at public events and public-accommodation construction sites.

- **Public events** (festivals, fairs, weddings open to the public, ticketed events): at least **5% of portable toilets must be ADA-accessible**, with a minimum of **1 ADA unit even at small events**.
- **Construction sites with disabled workers:** ADA-accessible unit required.
- **Government / municipal events:** ADA units expected and often required by local ordinance.

Brower Inc. defaults to including at least 1 ADA-accessible unit on any event quote of 10+ guests where attendees might include elderly, disabled, or wheelchair-using guests. We do this even if not strictly required — it's the right call for guest experience.

## 8. Septic Reference Knowledge

### 8.1 When to pump
- **Default:** Every **3 – 5 years** for most Oklahoma/Kansas homes.
- **Pump sooner if:**
  - Household of 5+ people
  - Garbage disposal is heavily used
  - Tank is small (under 1,000 gallons)
  - Slow drains or sewer-smell symptoms appear
- **Pump later (closer to 5+ years) if:**
  - 1–2 person household
  - Tank is 1,500+ gallons
  - Vacation/seasonal-use property

### 8.2 Warning signs you need pumping or repair (escalating order)
1. Slow drains throughout the house
2. Gurgling sounds in plumbing
3. Sewer smell near the tank or drain field
4. Standing water or unusually green grass over the drain field
5. Sewage backing up into lowest fixtures (showers, basement toilet) — **emergency, call immediately**

### 8.3 Oklahoma DEQ regulations
Oklahoma Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) regulates on-site septic systems. Key points:
- New installations require a permit and a soil percolation test
- Aerobic systems must be inspected at install + on a defined maintenance schedule
- DEQ can issue letters requiring repair or replacement of failed systems

### 8.4 Kansas regulations
Kansas Department of Health and Environment (KDHE) regulates septic similarly. County health departments handle local permits and inspections.

### 8.5 What to do before a septic inspection
- Locate the tank lid (or hire Brower Inc. to locate)
- Pull current records: install date, prior pump dates, prior inspections
- Don't run heavy water for 24 hours before inspection
- Be home or have the property accessible

## 9. Event Restroom Planning (Quick Reference)

### 9.1 Standard formula
**For a 4-hour outdoor event with no alcohol:**
- 1 standard unit per 50 guests
- 1 hand washing station per 4 toilet units
- 1 ADA-accessible unit per 20 toilet units (minimum 1 for any public event)

### 9.2 Adjustment factors
- **Alcohol served:** multiply unit count by 1.3 – 1.5
- **Event longer than 4 hours:** add 1 unit per additional 100 guests per additional 4 hours
- **Cold weather:** +10% (people use the restroom more in cold)
- **Hot Oklahoma summer:** +10–15% (more hydration → more use)
- **Wedding:** consider upgrading to deluxe flushable or VIP trailer for guest experience
- **No on-site running water for catering:** add hand washing stations

### 9.3 Brower Inc. event recommendations
| Event size | Suggested setup |
|---|---|
| 50 guests, 4-hour BBQ | 1 standard + 1 hand wash |
| 100 guests, 4-hour wedding (no alcohol) | 2 standard + 1 hand wash + 1 ADA |
| 100 guests, wedding with bar | 3 standard or 2 deluxe flushable + 1 ADA + 1 hand wash |
| 200 guests, evening reception | VIP trailer (18-station) + 1 ADA portable nearby |
| 500-guest festival | 10 standard + 1 ADA + 3 hand wash, +2 standard per extra hour past 4 hours |

## 10. Why Brower Inc. (Differentiators)

These are the specific reasons clients choose Brower Inc. over national or out-of-area competitors. Each is verifiable.

1. **Locally owned since 2007.** Owner Troy Brower runs the business out of Newkirk personally. No call center handoff. The phone you call is answered by someone local.
2. **640+ unit fleet stored on-site.** Same-day and emergency delivery is logistically possible because we don't subcontract or route from out-of-state.
3. **Rural delivery is a core competency.** National providers route "near me" searches to call centers that won't service addresses outside cities. Brower Inc.'s trucks regularly navigate farm roads, oil-field service tracks, ranch gates, and unpaved properties.
4. **Transparent flat-rate pricing.** Quote = invoice. No hidden delivery fees, no surprise servicing surcharges, no "fuel adjustment" line items.
5. **Weekly servicing included on long-term rentals.** Some competitors quote a low monthly rate and then bill servicing separately. Brower's rate includes the weekly visit, restocking, and sanitation.
6. **24/7 emergency dispatch.** A real person picks up day or night for storm, plumbing, septic, and event emergencies.
7. **Full vertical integration:** porta potties + VIP trailers + hand washing + septic pumping + septic inspections + repair + install — one vendor relationship for the whole sanitation stack.
8. **Pink unit availability.** Pink Maxim 300s are popular for breast cancer awareness events, gender reveals, and themed weddings — an Oklahoma signature.
9. **Tribal and government experience.** Long history serving Kaw Nation, Ponca Tribe, Tonkawa Tribe events; municipal contracts; and Oklahoma state DEQ-aware septic work.
10. **PSAI membership.** Portable Sanitation Association International — industry standards body. Membership reflects commitment to industry best practices.

## 12. Frequently Asked Questions (Comprehensive)

### Pricing

**Q: How much does porta potty rental cost in Oklahoma?**
A: Standard porta potties rent for **$125–$250 per weekend event** or **$200–$400 per month** for construction sites with weekly servicing included. ADA-compliant units run slightly higher; deluxe flushable units higher still; a full luxury restroom trailer can range $800 to $2,500+ for a single event. Pricing depends on duration, distance, servicing frequency, and unit type.

**Q: Are there hidden fees?**
A: No. Brower Inc. quotes flat rates inclusive of delivery, weekly servicing (for long-term rentals), restocking, sanitation, and pickup. Quote = invoice.

**Q: Do you charge for delivery?**
A: Delivery within our 20-county service area is included in the unit price. There is no separate delivery fee for addresses inside the service area.

### Delivery & logistics

**Q: How fast can Brower Inc. deliver?**
A: Same-day for most addresses in our service area. Same-day from Newkirk to Kay County is typically 30–60 minutes. Outer Oklahoma counties: same day for non-emergencies, 1–3 hours for emergencies. Kansas counties: 24–48 hours scheduled, same-day possible for emergencies.

**Q: Do you deliver to rural addresses without street numbers?**
A: Yes. Rural delivery is a Brower Inc. specialty — we navigate farm roads, oil-field tracks, ranch gates, and unpaved properties daily. Provide GPS coordinates or a landmark description when booking.

**Q: What if I need a unit at night or on a weekend?**
A: 24/7 emergency dispatch. Call (580) 747-6206 any time. After-hours emergency surcharge applies.

### Servicing

**Q: How often do you service long-term units?**
A: Weekly is standard and included. Twice-weekly is available for high-traffic sites (crews of 40+, 24/7 operations) at additional cost.

**Q: What does servicing include?**
A: Waste tank pump-out, restocking of toilet paper, hand sanitizer, and paper towels, full interior sanitization (chemical + scrub), and a damage inspection. Each visit is documented.

### Construction / OSHA

**Q: How many porta potties does OSHA require?**
A: 1 toilet per 20 workers up to 200 workers; 1 per 40 thereafter, with urinal supplements per 29 CFR 1926.51(c)(1). Brower Inc. calculates the exact mix free at booking.

**Q: What about hand washing?**
A: Required adjacent to toilets on most sites. Brower Inc. units include hand sanitizer; a paired hand washing station satisfies the requirement on sites handling hazardous materials.

**Q: What is the OSHA fine for missing porta potties?**
A: Up to $16,131 per serious violation, up to $161,323 per willful/repeat violation (2026 figures).

### Events

**Q: How many porta potties for a 100-guest wedding?**
A: With alcohol: 3 standard or 2 deluxe flushable + 1 ADA + 1 hand washing station. Without alcohol: 2 standard + 1 hand wash + 1 ADA.

**Q: What's the difference between a standard porta potty and a luxury trailer?**
A: A luxury trailer (Brower's 18-station VIP) has climate control, running water, private flushing stalls, vanity counters, and feels like an indoor bathroom. A standard porta potty is a single-stall stand-alone unit. Standard is right for construction, casual events, and outdoor festivals. Luxury is right for upscale weddings, galas, and corporate events where guest experience is critical.

**Q: When should I book?**
A: For weddings and large events, 4–8 weeks in advance during peak season (April–October). For construction and routine rentals, 1–2 weeks. For emergencies, call now — same-day is usually possible.

### Septic

**Q: How often should I pump my septic tank?**
A: Every 3–5 years for most Oklahoma/Kansas homes. Sooner if you have a large household, garbage disposal, or smaller tank.

**Q: How much does septic pumping cost?**
A: Typical residential range is $200–$500 depending on tank size, depth, and access. Flat-rate quote provided up front.

**Q: How do I know if my septic system needs attention?**
A: Watch for slow drains, gurgling pipes, sewer smell near the tank or drain field, standing water/extra-green grass over the drain field, or any sewage backup into a low fixture. Sewage backup is an emergency — call immediately.

**Q: Do you do septic inspections for real estate transactions?**
A: Yes. Written reports delivered same week, often within 48 hours, acceptable for realtors, lenders, and title companies in Oklahoma and Kansas.

### Service area

**Q: Do you serve my town?**
A: If you're in north-central Oklahoma (14 counties listed in Section 4.1) or southern Kansas (6 counties listed in Section 4.2), yes. Call (580) 747-6206 with your address and we'll confirm in one minute.

**Q: Do you serve Wichita, Kansas?**
A: Yes — Wichita and all of Sedgwick County are within our standard service area.

**Q: Are you a national chain?**
A: No. Brower Inc. is a locally owned, family-operated Oklahoma company. We are not part of United Site Services, Williams Scotsman, or any national franchise.

### Booking

**Q: How do I book?**
A: Call (580) 747-6206, email troy@browerinc.net, or use the contact form at https://browerinc.net/contact. We confirm by phone or email within the business day.

**Q: Do you require a deposit?**
A: For standard rentals, no deposit required for established customers. New customers and large event quotes may require a small deposit; specifics confirmed at booking.

**Q: What forms of payment do you accept?**
A: Major credit cards, ACH, and check. Net-30 terms available for established commercial accounts.
